'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the [[Crate (Shayzien Styles)|crate]], the chatbox message "The drawers{{sic}} are locked! There is a huge hand print left on them{{Sic}}." is displayed, hinting that you must kill a [[hill giant]] to get the key.
